question: The Battle of Talikota (1565) led to the decline of which empire ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijayanagara Empire**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Battle of Talikota** was fought on **January 26, 1565**, between the forces of the **Vijayanagara Empire** and the combined armies of the **Deccan Sultanates** (Bijapur, Ahmadnagar, Golconda, and Bidar).
 
• This battle marked the beginning of the decline of the **Vijayanagara Empire**, which was one of the most powerful empires in South India during its peak.
 
• The defeat of the Vijayanagara forces, led by their ruler **Aliya Rama Raya**, led to the destruction of their capital city, **Hampi**, and the eventual disintegration of the empire.
 
• The combined forces of the Deccan Sultanates overpowered the Vijayanagara army by using superior military strategies, including the betrayal of key commanders of the Vijayanagara forces.
